run_mcp_server: run the Hermes MCP server on stdio to expose messaging conversations as MCP tools
create_mcp_server: create an MCP server with tools for listing conversations, reading messages, and sending messages across platforms
list_conversations: list active messaging conversations across connected platforms filtered by platform name and search text
read_message_history: read recent messages from a conversation by session key with role, content, and timestamp
send_platform_message: send a text message to a platform conversation using platform:chat_id target format
poll_conversation_events: poll for new conversation events like messages and approval requests with cursor-based pagination
manage_approval_requests: list pending approval requests and respond with allow-once, allow-always, or deny decisions
fetch_message_attachments: list non-text attachments such as images and media files from a specific message
